name: Manhattan Community Garden Sites Data
description:
This dataset lists community garden sites in Manhattan, New York City, with 151 sampled rows and 14 columns. Each record describes a single garden location and includes its type (school garden, community garden, NYCHA property, or senior center), name, street address, and contact information, which is often an email address. It also provides geographic and administrative details: postcode, borough (Manhattan for all records), latitude and longitude, community board, council district, census tract, building identification number (BIN), borough-block-lot number (BBL), and neighborhood tabulation area (NTA). About 7% of rows are missing the location-related fields, and a small number lack contact or building identifiers.

The data can be used to map garden sites across Manhattan, compare how gardens are distributed by type and neighborhood, or analyze coverage by community board, council district, and census tract. Planners, researchers, and community groups could use it to identify gaps in garden access, support
